hero.prompt: A vast Egyptian night plain stretching to a distant horizon under an immense open sky, two twin luminous orbs hovering low — one a cool silver-teal, one a warm burnished gold — linked by a long graceful arc of flowing golden light that sweeps across the full breadth of the scene like a perfect assist, the arc mirroring the dark ribbon of the Nile curving far below, star-trails spiraling outward from each orb into the teal-and-gold nebula wash above, the sandy earth catching faint starlight, the whole landscape breathing with mutable air energy and the quiet electricity of connection over conquest, deep indigo-to-near-black palette (#16112c fading to #0b0a1b), soft gold accents (#d4af6a), teal-and-gold nebula wash, painterly editorial illustration, full-bleed wide 16:9 composition that fills the entire frame, ONE single continuous landscape scene, no split screen, no diptych, no two panels, no diagram, no chart wheel, no central framed card, no text or letters or numerals, no human faces

inline.titleEn: Common Misreadings vs What the Chart Actually Says
inline.altEn: Two-column comparison of three common misreadings of Mo Salah's birth chart against their accurate interpretations

linesEn: "Gemini means goals" — treats versatility as pure scoring output
"The Sun is the whole story" — ignores Moon, houses, and transits
"Birthday on match day guarantees a result" — treats a window of emphasis as a scripted outcome
linesZh: 「双子座意味着进球」——将多才多艺误解为单纯的射门能力
「太阳就是全部」——忽略月亮、宫位与过境
「生日当天必有好结果」——把强调窗口期当成确定性预言

linesEn: Gemini is the communicator archetype; the decisive assist fits the chart better than a hat-trick
Moon, houses, and transits carry equal weight; the full chart explains why a winger becomes a creator at 34
A natal activation is a window of tendency, never a guaranteed scoreline
linesZh: 双子座是传播者原型；关键助攻比帽子戏法更符合星盘逻辑
月亮、宫位与过境同等重要；完整星盘才能解释为何边锋在34岁转型为组织者
本命激活是一个倾向窗口，绝非确定性的比分预测
